params.body:
## What

Every tag a model writes now passes the Gentells Standard before it is stored, and what the check changes is counted.

- **`packages/core/conform.mjs`**: `conformClassification` and `conformConceptTopics` run each tag through the Standard's own matching rule, the one `taxonomy.mjs` already uses for regions and cohorts:
  - a spelling of a known term becomes its id;
  - a retired term becomes its replacement;
  - anything else is dropped.
- **Where it runs:** in `classifySignal`, which every classification passes through (topics, regions, voice), and in `writeConcept` (a concept's topics). The voice is checked against `Signal.voice` in the Standard (peer, owned, earned, media). Classify and its callers needed no change.
- **What it records:** a `conform_log` row per day, stage, field, value and outcome (corrected or dropped). `/api/elixir` reports the last seven days under `extra.conform`, with the values dropped most.
- **What it adds to the taxonomy:** `canonicalTopic(s)`, `VOICES` and `canonicalVoice` in `taxonomy.mjs`, both lists read from the Standard.
- **`bin/conform-audit.mjs`**: read only. It shows what the check would change in the signals classified in the last 30 days (`--days N` for another window) and in live concepts.

## Why

Until now only regions were matched against the Standard. Classify's `topic_tags` and `poem_type`, and a concept's topics from enrich, went into the store as the model wrote them. A prompt that drifted showed up weeks later as odd trends, never as a number. With this change, drift is a count that Elixir can see.

## What it does not do yet

- It does not rewrite old rows. Run `node bin/conform-audit.mjs` on the box first; a backfill is decided on what it prints.
- Elixir doesn't judge `extra.conform` yet. It only appears as a measurement; a threshold is a separate change in the elixir repo, once a normal week's numbers are known.
- Enrich's related and opposing concept ids are not checked here. The weekly graph drain already removes links to concepts that don't exist; a check at write time is a follow-up.

## Tests

- **`test/conform.test.mjs`** (6 tests):
  - correcting and dropping, each with a note saying which tag;
  - a voice outside the Standard is dropped, not guessed;
  - fields the caller did not send are left alone;
  - the topic and voice lists come from the Standard;
  - `classifySignal` stores only tags that pass and counts the rest;
  - `writeConcept` keeps only known topics.
- **`npm test`:** 1,124 pass and 6 fail. All six are `report-render` tests, failing on `spawnSync pdftoppm ENOENT` because poppler is not installed on the workbench where I ran them; they don't touch this change.
params.title: A gate between the model and the store: tags meet the Standard
